verdict.rationale: Fathom lists a 'Conversational meeting assistant' and ships a first-party MCP server. That server lets users reach their Fathom meeting data through natural language in ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP clients. The evidence shows natural-language access to meeting data, not natural-language operation of the product as a whole, and the conversational assistant gets only a single pricing-page mention. Missing for 10: documentation of which actions can be performed by natural-language command beyond querying meeting data (e.g., configuring settings, managing recordings or webhooks), in-depth docs on the conversational assistant's capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
Connect Fathom to any MCP-compatible tool using the server URL below, then authenticate to access your meeting data.
